description: This Java interface defines an authorization enforcer for Server-Sent Events (SSE) connections in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It declares a method for checking authorization based on the request context and headers, which may throw exceptions or return a future indicating success or failure.

classes.name: SseAuthorizationEnforcer
classes.description: An interface for enforcing authorization checks when establishing SSE connections.

methods.name: checkAuthorization
methods.description: Ensures that the establishment of an SSE connection is authorized for the given request context and headers. Returns a CompletionStage that completes successfully if authorized, or exceptionally if not.
